newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNAC takes 16 pct of Lufthansa catering unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: CNAC takes 16 pct of Lufthansa catering unit - paper.

text.p: China National Aviation Corp (CNAC) has taken a 16 percent stake in Lufthansa's catering division, LSG Lufthansa Service Hong Kong, for an undisclosed sum, the South China Morning Post said on Wednesday.
The paper said it would give CNAC a foothold in the 20,000 square metre catering facility Lufthansa was building at Hong Kong's new international Chek Lap Kok airport.
LSG Lufthansa, Cathay Pacific Catering Services and Gate Gourmet Hong Kong are the three firms that have been given a franchise to operate out of Chek Lap Kok.
The companies' officals were not immediately available to comment on the report.
